import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 7.5,
    'text.usetex': False,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
})

steps = [0, 1, 2, 3]
step_labels = ['SFT', '500', '1000', '1500']

acc_seen   = [83.10, 73.03, 73.08, 73.22]
acc_unseen = [71.67, 71.16, 71.14, 71.10]

lz_seen   = [-0.395, 3.410, 3.625, 3.539]
lz_unseen = [3.278, 7.000, 6.948, 6.859]
lz_gap = [u - s for u, s in zip(lz_unseen, lz_seen)]

C_SEEN = '#b2182b'
C_UNSEEN = '#2166ac'
C_LZ = '#1b7837'

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.8))
ax2 = ax1.twinx()

ax1.fill_between(steps, acc_unseen, acc_seen, alpha=0.08, color=C_SEEN, zorder=1)

line_seen, = ax1.plot(steps, acc_seen, '-s', color=C_SEEN, markersize=7,
                      linewidth=1.8, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5,
                      zorder=5, label='Acc (seen items)')
line_unseen, = ax1.plot(steps, acc_unseen, '--o', color=C_UNSEEN, markersize=6,
                        linewidth=1.8, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5,
                        zorder=5, label='Acc (unseen items)')

line_lz, = ax2.plot(steps, lz_gap, '-D', color=C_LZ, markersize=7,
                    linewidth=1.8, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5,
                    zorder=5, label=r'$\ell_z^*$ gap (unseen$-$seen)')

ax1.annotate('', xy=(0, acc_unseen[0]), xytext=(0, acc_seen[0]),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#888888', lw=0.8))
ax1.text(0.15, (acc_seen[0] + acc_unseen[0]) / 2, '11pp',
         fontsize=7, color='#888888', ha='left', va='center')

ax1.annotate('accuracy gap\nerased', xy=(1.5, 73.5), xytext=(1.8, 79.5),
             fontsize=7, color='#888888', style='italic',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=0.8),
             zorder=10)

ax2.annotate('pattern gap\npersists', xy=(2.5, lz_gap[2]), xytext=(2.5, 2.7),
             fontsize=7, color=C_LZ, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_LZ, lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
             zorder=10)

ax1.set_xlabel('GRPO Training Steps')
ax1.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)')
ax2.set_ylabel(r'$\ell_z^*$ gap (unseen $-$ seen)', color=C_LZ)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=C_LZ)

ax1.set_xticks(steps)
ax1.set_xticklabels(step_labels)
ax1.set_ylim(68, 86)
ax2.set_ylim(2.50, 4.50)

ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

lines = [line_seen, line_unseen, line_lz]
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
leg = ax1.legend(lines, labels, loc='lower left',
                 framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                 borderpad=0.4, handletextpad=0.4, handlelength=1.8,
                 fontsize=7)
leg.get_frame().set_linewidth(0.4)

fig.text(0.5, -0.02,
         r'$N{=}1$ (Qwen-2.5-7B, 15% MMLU contamination $\rightarrow$ GRPO)',
         ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#666666', style='italic')

plt.tight_layout()

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'figures' / 'paper'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(out / 'fig_grpo.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(out / 'fig_grpo.png', format='png')
plt.close()
print(f"Done. Files saved to {out}")
